subject: Unexpected nightly batch duplication — request for invoice evidence and credit
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@velox.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@velox.ai, billing@velox.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 23:05:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice spike from nightly batch (Apr 20) — evidence request

Hi Priyom,

We pulled the April 20 invoice this evening and see a ~1.2M token increase between 02:00-03:00 UTC that doesn't match any traffic from our side. Attached is the invoice PDF (velox_invoice_20270420.pdf).

Can you send the request-level evidence for that hour (request IDs, timestamps, model, region) and any explanation for why tokens would spike like that overnight? Our AR team is asking for a timeline — if this was a platform issue, we will need a provisional credit while we investigate.

Appreciate a quick turnaround; we close the books on Friday.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Payments
Velox AI

[attachment: velox_invoice_20270420.pdf]

Samir — thanks for flagging and for attaching the invoice. I'm escalating this to our usage ops and infra leads (cc'ed).

Immediate plan:
- We will snapshot per-request logs for 02:00-03:30 UTC and provide a sampled CSV with request_id, timestamp, model, token_count, and route.
- If we confirm an internal replay/duplication, we'll propose a provisional credit and submit a permanent adjustment.
- ETA: initial evidence within 8 hours, full analysis within 48 hours.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll prioritize this.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@velox.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice spike from nightly batch (Apr 20) — evidence request

FWIW from infra side (quick summary of findings so far):

- We correlated the token spike to a batch job (ingest-replay-service) that ran a replay window from 01:45–03:10 UTC on 2027-04-20.
- Root cause: a scheduled clock-shift in a staging region created overlapping ULIDs for a subset of tenant uploads; the replay job lacked a strict idempotency check for that particular pipeline path. That allowed some payloads to be reprocessed and re-tokenized.

Sample evidence (redacted):
> request_id: 8f3a2c7b-20270420T014812Z
> original_received_at: 2027-04-19T23:48:12Z
> replay_processed_at: 2027-04-20T02:12:05Z
> model: rdx-std-8k
> token_count: 512

We see ~12k distinct request_ids replayed twice in that window for Velox AI's tenant id. The ingest logs and tokenization samples are attached (ingest-lambda-replay.log, tokenization-sample.jsonl).

Immediate recommendation:
1) Apply a retroactive de-duplication pass for Velox's tenant ingestion for the affected interval; this will reduce billed tokens to match original ingestion.
2) Issue a provisional credit equal to the token delta while the de-dupe job runs (we can apply as an invoice credit or one-off dollar credit).
3) Deploy a hotfix to enforce idempotency checks in the replay path and add a regression test.

I'll coordinate the de-dupe job with infra; ETA for de-dupe run is ~6 hours from now. Let me know if Velox prefers a credit or invoice adjustment.

— Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

[attachment: ingest-lambda-replay.log]
[attachment: tokenization-sample.jsonl]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@velox.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice spike from nightly batch (Apr 20) — evidence request

Samir — quick update and proposed resolution.

Thanks for your patience. Our SRE team confirmed that a replay window reprocessed a subset of your payloads overnight due to an idempotency gap introduced by a clock-shift in staging. We have:
- Identified ~1.2M duplicated tokens attributable to Velox tenant for 02:00–03:10 UTC.
- Kicked off a retroactive de-duplication job (in progress) that will remove duplicate token records from billing metering.
- Proposed remedy: provisional credit of $2,400 while we complete de-duplication and reconcile the invoice.

Action items for Velox:
- Please confirm whether you prefer a provisional invoice credit now (applied to Apr invoice) or a one-off ACH refund after reconciliation.
- We'll provide a CSV export with request-level before/after counts and a redacted log sample for audit.

Preventive measures we've already scheduled:
- Hotfix to enforce idempotency in replay paths (deploy tonight).
- New regression test in CI for clock-shifted ULIDs.
- Monthly audit of replay jobs and an alert if a tenant has >10% traffic reprocessed in a rolling 24h window.

I've attached the provisional-credit-summary.xlsx and a remediation doc link for your internal finance team. If this plan looks good, we'll apply the provisional credit immediately and follow up with the final reconciliation.

Please let me know how you'd like to proceed — if you're okay, I'll apply the credit now and share the CSV as soon as de-dupe completes (expected within 6–10 hours).

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
